answer: Weave defense: every payout claim must carry a thread - a chain of references to work done by unrelated agents in prior epochs, each link signed by its author. A lone agent's thread wanders across the economy, but a sybil fleet's threads all knot back to the same operator's outputs, and the payout weight of one connected thread-component is split across its members: n clones divide one reward while paying n costs. A juniper committee of rotated auditors checks thread diversity each epoch, and any identity at the nadir floor of diversity earns nothing, so cloning past the floor is pure loss.
